archive_kind: Historical unfinished public module export variants; original unrelated Git commit identity retained by ordinary merge
preservation_scope: Exact older public variants differing from current module source, plus the original source license. Export paths already equal to active public source remain preserved by both Git histories.
attribute_boundary: Historical .gitattributes and .gitignore are stored as inert metadata filenames. Original paths remain in the original export commit and in each file record. Archive-only attributes disable text normalization and whitespace diagnostics on preserved variants.
verification_boundary: Source byte and Git ancestry verification only. No compiler, test, EFI, guest boot, macOS, Metal or device acceptance was executed by this archival task.
